name: Jasmine Gajra Scrunchie Set
short: Cloud-soft crochet scrunchies inspired by fresh jasmine gajras, finished with hand-stitched green leaves.
description:
Our Jasmine Gajra Scrunchies capture the beauty of fresh mogra flowers in yarn that never wilts. Every cluster of tiny petals is crocheted by hand, one popcorn stitch at a time, then finished with a tie of deep green leaves.
They sit gently on the wrist or wrap a bun, a ponytail or a braid, and look stunning with festive outfits, mehndi functions and Eid. Presented in a woven basket, the set makes a lovely gift.

details.label: Colours
details.value: Ivory white with green leaves (red rose option on request)

details.label: Fits
details.value: Stretchy elastic, suits hair and wrist

name: Floral Braid Paranda
short: A trail of tiny crochet blossoms and a vivid green tassel to dress up any braid.
description:
Inspired by traditional paranda and floral hair jewellery, this piece weaves delicate white crochet flowers and green buds along the length of your braid, ending in a handmade yarn tassel with pearl detail.
It stays light, never pulls on the hair, and adds an instant festive touch to shalwar kameez, lehnga or a simple everyday kurta.

details.label: Colours
details.value: White blossoms, green leaves and tassel

details.label: Care
details.value: Spot clean, keep away from perfume

features: Perfect for Eid, weddings and mehndi
Tassel colour can be matched to your outfit

name: Gajra Bracelet
short: A plush, jasmine-inspired crochet bracelet in creamy white, light as a flower.
description:
This chunky gajra bracelet is built from dozens of tiny textured pom-pom stitches that look just like clustered jasmine buds. It feels soft against the skin and is made with an elastic core, so it slips on easily and stays put.
Wear it alone for a clean, elegant look or stack it with bangles and gold jewellery for festive occasions.

details.label: Colour
details.value: Cream white with green leaf accent

name: Bow Crochet Shoulder Bag
short: A sturdy cream shoulder bag in chunky cotton cord, finished with a berry-coloured bow.
description:
Made from thick, tightly worked cotton cord, this shoulder bag keeps its shape and carries your daily essentials with ease. The contrasting berry rim and hand-crocheted bow add a quiet pop of colour, and the double rope handles sit comfortably on the shoulder.
A detachable key ring on the bow lets you clip on a keychain or charm. Wear it with abayas, kurtas or casual outfits.

details.label: Colours
details.value: Cream with berry bow (other colours on request)

details.label: Care
details.value: Spot clean, do not machine wash

features: Holds phone, wallet, keys and more
Made to order in your colours

name: Rose Bucket Bag
short: A romantic cream bucket bag crowned with a ring of hand-crocheted red roses.
description:
Our signature Rose Bucket Bag is worked in a rich textured stitch and gathers softly at the top, where a garland of deep red crochet roses and green leaves forms a beautiful floral border.
It comes with a long crossbody strap that attaches with silver clasps, so you can wear it on the shoulder or across the body. Dressy enough for dawats and weddings, easy enough for everyday.

details.label: Colours
details.value: Cream with red roses (other rose colours on request)

details.label: Care
details.value: Spot clean, reshape and air dry

name: Heart Bow Keychain
short: A tiny cream crochet bow with embroidered pink hearts and a golden ring.
description:
This dainty crochet bow keychain is stitched in a firm, even fabric so it holds its beautiful shape. Two little pink hearts are embroidered by hand on the bow and tail, and a gold-tone chain and ring finish it off.
Hang it on your keys, backpack or handbag, or tuck it into a gift box. It is small, light and endlessly cute.
